take: Pittsburgh announced it placed defenseman Trevor van Riemsdyk on injured reserve. He averaged 18.8 minutes a night over five games, killing penalties on the third pair, and Pittsburgh took 45.5% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (a measure of chance quality) while he played. The team's share was about nine points better when he sat. Spencer Stastney has already moved in beside Letang in the five games since van Riemsdyk went out, so he looks like the one to keep those minutes. The Penguins are 3-6-1.
